stem:
Which images show issues directly affecting civilians on the home front during World War II?

Select THREE correct answers.

options.text: Image with large guns labeled UNITED we are strong, UNITED we will win
Image with men in military uniforms seated and standing
Poster that reads GROW IT YOURSELF PLAN A FARM GARDEN NOW with plants
Image of children putting items in a barrel labeled SCRAP METALS
Poster with soldiers and planes with the words BUY WAR BONDS
Image of two soldiers sitting and eating in a jungle
